source.description:
PROBLEM
The reply-based delivery criterion is implemented and unit-tested, and the inbound path is confirmed by a live coordinator, but no Specialist has yet asked a question over the peer channel and been resumed by a real reply. unitAI-rrdnt.22 (Phase 6 ask/escalate) and unitAI-rrdnt.25 (registration and reply-as-delivery) are both closed, so nothing open tracks the end-to-end proof. Marking the criterion superseded was correct; marking it met is not, and the gap between those two is exactly the finding that produced the fourth boundary.

SUCCESS
A Specialist running under NativeActivationHost pushes a question to a busy Claude coordinator, that coordinator replies, the reply is correlated by inReplyTo, the pending record moves from sent_unconfirmed to delivered, and the child resumes in the same session. Acceptance AX, observed rather than inferred.

SCRUTINY
HIGH

Rationale: this bead's own CONSTRAINTS record that THREE separate claims about this transport were falsified by live probes after passing on inspection — the procStart format, the receipt premise, and the prior-state boundary on reply confirmation. The receipt premise has since failed a fourth time (unitAI-rrdnt.45: attemptDelivery returned true with no deliver hook, so a pending record reached 'delivered' with no receiver). A path with that record does not get a routine review.

SCOPE
Wiring the existing pieces and running the observation. All parts exist: PeerAdapter.ask() and the reply-as-delivery boundaries (src/activation/transport/), registration (peer-registration.ts), and the ask/escalate path on a live AgentSession (ask-tool.ts, native-host.ts).

NON_GOALS
No new transport. No change to the four confirmation boundaries without evidence that one of them is wrong.

CONSTRAINTS
The proof must be a live coordinator, not a fixture. Three separate claims about this transport have now been falsified by live probes after passing on inspection or on a reading of pi-claude-link: the procStart format, the receipt premise, and the prior-state boundary on reply confirmation. pi-claude-link is evidence of what pi-claude-link sends, never a specification of what Claude Code sends. Do not close on a green unit test.

VALIDATION
1. A pending record for a question reaches delivered against a reply carrying inReplyTo equal to its message id.
2. The Specialist resumes on that reply in the same session.
3. AY: a completion notification tied to a validated ActivationResult.
4. With the peer channel unavailable, the same question is still answerable through specialist_status and the record does NOT reach delivered.

OUTPUT
Observed evidence of AX and AY, and whichever of the four boundaries the observation changes, if any.
source.notes:
Coordinator note 2026-09-08: NOT satisfied by the pi-extension lane's AX proof. That proof ran over the Pi extension with a pi coordinator and the in-process ask tool; .30 requires the PEER channel with a live Claude coordinator and the inReplyTo correlation. Different path, different evidence.

Now blocked on .45 for a concrete reason: the wakeup lane measured that InteractionTransport.attemptDelivery returned true whenever no deliver hook was wired, so a pending record went straight to 'delivered' without any receipt. .30's VALIDATION 1 asks for a record that reaches delivered AGAINST a reply carrying inReplyTo — which cannot be distinguished from the bug's behaviour until the fix lands. Proving .30 on the current code would prove nothing.

This is the fourth falsified-claim entry for this transport, and it fits the bead's own CONSTRAINTS: three prior claims passed on inspection and failed live. The receipt premise has now failed twice.
source.title: Prove AX end to end: a real Specialist push confirmed by a real reply
